name: Firecrawl Search
summary: Web search from the Firecrawl scraping platform, optionally with the full page of each result. 1,000 free credits every month without a card; a search of up to 10 results costs 2 credits, so about 500 searches.

allowance.text: 1,000 credits every month, refreshed monthly, no credit card required

rate_limits.note: Free plan: /search 10 requests a minute; 2 concurrent browsers.

account_note: Search also works without a key, capped per IP address per day (the caps aren't published); we test with a key.

locale.note: country takes an ISO country code; location (e.g. "Netherlands") also geo-targets, from Firecrawl's list of supported locations.
